thesis: Partners with founders from day one to build enduring, category-defining companies. Pattern-matches against a 50-year history of compounding outcomes. Looks for relentless founders attacking large, monetizable markets with structural defensibility.
what_they_fund: Generalist with strongest concentration in enterprise software, AI infrastructure, fintech, consumer marketplaces, and developer tools. Will lean into deep-tech and frontier categories if the team is credible.
valuation_lens: Pays a premium for category-defining outliers. Typical seed post-money: $15M-$40M, willing to go higher ($60M-$100M) for elite founders in AI/infra in 2024-2026.
famous_for: Apple, Google, Stripe, WhatsApp, Airbnb, Nvidia, ByteDance, Snowflake, OpenAI, Klarna
partner_voice: Direct, founder-first, long-time-horizon. Asks 'what's the prepared mind?' and 'why now?'. Skeptical of features-not-companies and undifferentiated AI wrappers.

thesis: Software is eating the world; AI is eating software. Backs technical founders building platform-shifting companies with a strong narrative and operator support. Active investor with deep media + recruiting + GTM platform.
what_they_fund: Heavy in AI (apps + infrastructure), crypto/web3, bio + healthcare, American Dynamism (defense, aerospace, manufacturing), fintech, games, and consumer.
seed_check_range: $500K-$5M, $5M-$15M for AI infra or American Dynamism
valuation_lens: Aggressive on narrative-driven categories. AI infra seeds: $30M-$80M post-money. Consumer or unproven categories: $10M-$25M.
famous_for: Coinbase, Databricks, Figma, GitHub, Instacart, Lyft, Roblox, Anduril, Character.AI, Mistral
partner_voice: Thesis-driven, opinionated, narrative-heavy. Wants to see a manifesto, not just a product. Allergic to incrementalism. Will push back hard on whether the market is large enough.

thesis: Small partnership, equal partners, one investment per partner per year. Hands-on, high-conviction, low-volume. Looks for category-defining consumer and enterprise companies with strong network effects.
what_they_fund: Marketplaces, consumer apps, enterprise SaaS with bottom-up adoption, developer-first products. Less active in deep tech and bio.
seed_check_range: $3M-$8M, leads Series A more often than seed
valuation_lens: Conviction-driven, will pay up for the right team. Seed post-money: $20M-$50M. Avoids high-priced rounds without clear moat.
famous_for: eBay, Uber, Snap, Twitter, Instagram, Discord, Dropbox, Asana, Confluent, Zillow
partner_voice: Quiet, partner-led, board-focused. Asks deep product questions and probes founder-market fit. Skeptical of capital-intensive go-to-market plays.

thesis: 'Prepared mind' framework: invest in founders who have spent years thinking about a problem before pitching it. Global presence (US, Europe, India). Strong in enterprise infrastructure and bottom-up SaaS.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, data infrastructure, security, developer tools, fintech, and select consumer.
valuation_lens: Disciplined. Seed post-money: $12M-$30M typical, will stretch to $40M-$60M for elite teams in hot infra categories.
famous_for: Atlassian, Slack, Dropbox, Facebook, Spotify, CrowdStrike, UiPath, Flipkart, Segment, Vercel
partner_voice: Analytical, ROI-focused, asks 'what's the wedge and the expansion path?'. Wants concrete bottom-up metrics and a credible enterprise GTM story.

thesis: Backs paradigm-shifting companies and contrarian founders. Manifesto: 'we wanted flying cars, instead we got 140 characters.' Heavy bets on hard tech, defense, biotech, crypto, space.
what_they_fund: Deep tech, defense, aerospace, biotech, AI, crypto. Allergic to incrementalism and 'me-too' SaaS.
seed_check_range: $1M-$10M, will write larger checks for hard-tech
valuation_lens: Pays premiums for moonshots with credible technical founders. Seed post-money: $20M-$60M typical, much higher for breakout hard-tech (SpaceX, Anduril precedents).
famous_for: Facebook, SpaceX, Palantir, Stripe, Airbnb, Anduril, Ramp, Wish, Affirm, Flexport
partner_voice: Provocative, contrarian, dismissive of safe bets. Wants to know what you believe that nobody else does. Will probe whether the technology is genuinely novel.

thesis: Backs entrepreneurs who turn bold ideas into global businesses. Strong on both sides of the Atlantic. Operator-heavy support model. Pattern: enterprise software, fintech, and category-defining consumer.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, fintech, infrastructure, marketplaces, consumer, gaming, AI.
valuation_lens: Disciplined but willing to pay for category leaders. Seed post-money: $15M-$35M typical.
famous_for: Adyen, Discord, Dropbox, Etsy, Figma, Notion, Revolut, Roblox, Slack, Wise
partner_voice: Pragmatic, GTM-focused, asks 'who's the buyer and what's the price point?'. Strong on unit economics from day one.

thesis: Multi-stage, multi-sector global firm. Backs founders attacking large markets across enterprise, consumer, fintech, healthcare, and AI. Strong India and SEA presence.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, AI, fintech, consumer, healthcare, frontier tech.
valuation_lens: Market-rate disciplined. Seed post-money: $12M-$30M typical, $30M-$60M for hot AI.
famous_for: Snap, AppDynamics, Mulesoft, Affirm, Carta, Rubrik, Stitch Fix, Epic Games, Faire
partner_voice: Operator-driven, asks 'what's the GTM motion and what's it cost to acquire a paying customer?'. Strong on early metrics.

thesis: Backs unreasonable founders. Multi-stage, multi-sector with deep technical orientation. Strong in AI, climate, biotech, fintech, hard tech.
what_they_fund: AI, climate tech, biotech, fintech, food, hard tech, healthcare, enterprise.
valuation_lens: Will pay up for technical depth, otherwise disciplined. Seed post-money: $10M-$30M typical.
famous_for: OpenAI (early), Square, Affirm, DoorDash, Impossible Foods, Quantumscape, Stripe (early), Instacart
partner_voice: Probing, technical, asks 'why hasn't this been built?'. Pushes on differentiation and IP.

thesis: Pure seed-stage. Backs first-time and second-time founders. Heavy platform support: First Round Review, community, recruiting, and a dollar-for-dollar founder network model.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, fintech, consumer, marketplaces, healthcare, AI applications.
valuation_lens: Seed-specialist discipline. Seed post-money: $8M-$20M typical, will stretch to $30M for elite founders.
famous_for: Uber, Square, Notion, Roblox, Warby Parker, Blue Apron, Looker, Mint, Hims, Clearbit
partner_voice: Founder-centric, community-driven, asks 'what's the founder-market fit story?' and 'why is now the moment?'.

thesis: 'Responsible innovation' frame: backs founders building applied AI, healthcare assurance, defense and intelligence, and global resilience. Has a 'Health Assurance' thesis explicitly trying to reshape US healthcare.
what_they_fund: Applied AI, healthcare, defense, fintech, consumer, climate, enterprise infrastructure.
valuation_lens: Mid-to-high. Seed post-money: $15M-$40M typical.
famous_for: Stripe, Snap, Airbnb, HubSpot, Lemonade, Livongo, Anduril, Mistral, Helsing, Commure
partner_voice: Thesis-led, asks 'how does this become a category-defining outcome 10 years from now?'. Particularly strong on healthcare and AI applied to regulated industries.

thesis: Backs founders building world-changing companies in enterprise, consumer, fintech, and hardtech. Long history; reset under newer partnership in past decade.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, AI, fintech, consumer, hardtech, cybersecurity.
valuation_lens: Market-rate. Seed post-money: $12M-$30M typical.
famous_for: Amazon, Google, Genentech, Nest, Slack, Robinhood, Coinbase, UiPath, Figma
partner_voice: Classic VC pattern-matching, asks 'why is this team uniquely positioned?' and 'what's the moat in 5 years?'.

thesis: Cloud, vertical SaaS, fintech, healthcare, consumer, AI. Famous for the 'Anti-Portfolio' (companies they passed on) and the 'BVP Nasdaq Emerging Cloud Index'. Disciplined.
what_they_fund: Cloud + SaaS, fintech, healthcare, consumer, AI, frontier tech.
valuation_lens: Disciplined on multiples. Seed post-money: $10M-$25M typical, will stretch for cloud category leaders.
famous_for: Shopify, LinkedIn, Twilio, Pinterest, Wix, Auth0, DocuSign, Yelp, Toast
partner_voice: Metrics-driven, asks 'what's the NDR and what's the magic number?'. Will quote you the BVP Cloud Index.

firm: GGV Capital (now Notable Capital / Granite Asia split, treat as Notable for US/global)
thesis: Backs founders building global category leaders. Cross-border DNA. Active in enterprise, consumer, fintech, and frontier tech.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, fintech, consumer, AI, marketplaces.
valuation_lens: Market-rate. Seed post-money: $10M-$25M typical.
famous_for: Airbnb, Alibaba, HashiCorp, Wish, Affirm, Slack, Square
partner_voice: Global-minded, asks 'how does this play in multiple geographies?' and 'what's the cross-border defensibility?'.

thesis: Concentrated, multi-stage. Heavy bets on AI, fintech, healthcare, consumer internet, and crypto. Often leads or co-leads with conviction.
what_they_fund: AI, fintech, healthcare, consumer, crypto.
valuation_lens: Pays up for category leaders. Seed post-money: $20M-$60M typical for AI.
famous_for: Stripe, Instagram, GitHub, Spotify, Robinhood, Twitch, Unity, OpenAI (late), Plaid
partner_voice: High-conviction, brief on diligence. Asks 'why are you the inevitable winner?'.

thesis: Pure fintech specialist. Backs founders reinventing financial services globally. Single-sector focus by design.
what_they_fund: Fintech only: banking, payments, lending, insurance, wealth, crypto, fintech infrastructure.
valuation_lens: Disciplined for fintech sub-sectors. Seed post-money: $10M-$30M typical, higher for crypto/payments infra.
famous_for: Robinhood, Coinbase, Nubank, Affirm, Revolut, Plaid, Mercado Bitcoin, Brex
partner_voice: Domain-deep, asks 'what's the regulatory moat?' and 'what's the unit economics relative to incumbents?'.

thesis: 'World-positive' investing. Backs founders attacking large markets in sustainability, healthcare, food, and human enablement. Mission-first, returns-driven.
what_they_fund: Climate, healthcare, food and ag, sustainable consumer, fintech with mission angle.
valuation_lens: Disciplined. Seed post-money: $8M-$20M typical.
famous_for: Beyond Meat, Diamond Foundry, Olipop, Proterra, Northvolt (early), Wild Earth
partner_voice: Mission-probing, asks 'what's the world-positive outcome at scale?' and 'is the unit economics actually defensible without subsidy?'.

thesis: Deep tech, sci-fi-grade ambition. Backs founders at the intersection of bits and atoms: biotech, robotics, AI, space, defense, materials.
what_they_fund: Biotech, robotics, AI infrastructure, space, defense, materials, neurotech.
valuation_lens: Pays up for technical novelty. Seed post-money: $15M-$50M typical for deep tech.
famous_for: Anduril, Planet Labs, Recursion, Hims, Latch, Variant Bio, Saildrone
partner_voice: Intellectually curious, asks 'what's the underlying scientific or engineering breakthrough?'. Allergic to consumer-app pitches.

firm: Matrix Partners (now Q Investment Partners in India / Matrix Partners in US separated)
thesis: Backs founders early. Strong on enterprise SaaS, AI infrastructure, fintech, and consumer marketplaces.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, fintech, AI, consumer marketplaces, developer tools.
valuation_lens: Market-rate. Seed post-money: $10M-$25M typical.
famous_for: HubSpot, Zendesk, Apple, Quora, Oculus, Canva, Afterpay, Klaviyo, FanDuel
partner_voice: Founder-friendly, asks 'what's the GTM wedge and how does it expand?'.

thesis: Multi-stage tech investor focused on enterprise software, infrastructure, industrial tech, and consumer internet.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, infrastructure, industrial tech, fintech, consumer.
valuation_lens: Disciplined. Seed post-money: $10M-$25M typical.
famous_for: Coupa, Wayfair, Glassdoor, Smartsheet, Splunk, PagerDuty
partner_voice: Pragmatic, asks 'what's the path to $100M ARR?'. Strong on industrial and B2B.

thesis: Backs technical founders applying software to legacy industries: healthcare, logistics, defense, government, biotech.
what_they_fund: Healthcare, logistics, defense, biotech, industrial software, fintech.
valuation_lens: Disciplined. Seed post-money: $10M-$30M typical, higher for defense.
famous_for: Palantir (founders' prior), Anduril (early), Oscar Health, Boom, Wish, Flock Safety
partner_voice: Domain-deep on regulated industries, asks 'what's the procurement motion and how long is the sales cycle?'.

thesis: Pure seed/early-stage. Backs technical founders at the earliest moment. Founder-first, hands-off operationally.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, consumer, hardware, AI, developer tools, fintech.
valuation_lens: Seed-disciplined. Seed post-money: $6M-$15M typical.
famous_for: Fitbit, Peloton, Ring, Duo Security, Hashicorp, WordPress (Automattic), Tray.io
partner_voice: Quiet, founder-aligned, asks 'what's the smallest version that proves the magic?'.

thesis: Accelerator + seed fund. Standard deal ($500K for 7%). Bet on founders, not theses. Volume-driven; will fund 200+ companies per batch.
what_they_fund: Everything: enterprise SaaS, AI, fintech, consumer, bio, hard tech, crypto, healthcare.
valuation_lens: Standardized: $500K SAFE at $1.7M cap + uncapped MFN on $375K. Effective post-batch valuation typically $10M-$30M for the seed round after demo day.
famous_for: Airbnb, Stripe, Coinbase, DoorDash, Instacart, Dropbox, Reddit, Twitch, GitLab, Faire, Rappi
partner_voice: Pragmatic, asks 'have you talked to users this week?' and 'what's the one metric you're moving?'.

thesis: Enterprise + consumer. Long-time-horizon partner-led model. Strong on infrastructure, security, AI, and marketplaces.
what_they_fund: Enterprise SaaS, AI, infrastructure, security, marketplaces, fintech.
valuation_lens: Pays up for category leaders. Seed post-money: $15M-$40M typical.
famous_for: Facebook, LinkedIn, Workday, Airbnb, Dropbox, Cloudera, Palo Alto Networks, Discord, Figma, Roblox
partner_voice: Operator-driven, asks 'what's the platform play in 3 years?' and 'how does this become inevitable?'.
